description: This dataset contains 20 cryoconite samples collected from the Flade Isblink ice cap, with coordinates ranging from latitude 81.5171 to 81.5212 and longitude ‑15.9056 to ‑15.8788, sampled on 2–3 August 2022. Each record provides geospatial information (latitude, longitude, elevation), a timestamp, and glaciological identifiers such as event, sample ID, depth, sample type, material classification and qualitative comments. A comprehensive suite of geochemical and radiochemical measurements is included: loss‑on‑ignition, carbon, and radioisotopes 137Cs, 210Pb, 214Pb, 241Am, 207Bi, 228Ac, 7Be, 40K, plutonium isotopes and their ratios, all with associated uncertainties. The data support investigations of radionuclide deposition, transport, and age‑dating in cryoconite and can be used for environmental monitoring, glaciological research, and radiochemical modeling.
